<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈192.103 Da. The formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₁₁H₁₄NO₂ (C₁₁H₁₄O₂N), whose exact monoisotopic mass is 192.1025 Da. This fits the required format CxHyOzX.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2N</final_answer>
